persons.name: Bhāgeśvara
persons.evidence: śrī śrī bhāgeśvara | śrīkarmmaṇāṃ tava ācāryasya pustakaṃ likhitaṃ

notes: The colophon names no era, but Guṇakāmadeva reigned around NS 300–316 (c. 1180–1196 CE), so NS 305 = c. 1185 CE fits. The line 'śrī śrī bhāgeśvara | śrīkarmmaṇāṃ tava ācāryasya pustakaṃ likhitaṃ' is obscure and possibly corrupt. One reading is that the book was copied for an ācārya named Bhāgeśvara. Another is that 'bhāgeśvara' is an invocation, which would leave the owner unnamed; perhaps read 'śrīkarmācāryasya', making the owner a karmācārya. That is why the owner is set at low confidence. The line may also have been added by a later hand. 'samasta svakriyāyeta' is corrupt. 'dokṣakam' stands for 'doṣakaḥ'.
